decisionsTitle: «Eveniment special» in the filter's «Tipul»: everything that is not a weekly series
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11, of the listing's collapsed «Filtre» panel, whose «Tipul» showed only «Alergare de grup» and «Concurs»:** «Aici la tip trebuie să pot vedea și evenimentele speciale».

**Decision.** The shared filter's type group gets one more box, «Eveniment special» / "Special event", in the address `?type=SPECIAL` (any case, `?type=special` too; `past-type=SPECIAL` in the past section, §611). It means what the site already calls a special event: every date that is not a date of a standing weekly series — `eventKind` (§709, `docs/REDESIGN.md` decision 9), derived from the series' cadence the public row already carries (`seriesCadence`), never a flag the club ticks. A race, a hike, a run held once, a coffee, a series every two weeks or every month, a series stopped with «Oprește recurența» (§275) are special; a «Ediție specială» (§168) stays a weekly date.

- **One more answer in the group, the group's OR kept.** An event carries its type AND, when it is special, «Eveniment special»: «Alergare de grup» with «Eveniment special» shows every group run and every special date; «Eveniment special» with «Trail» (another group) is AND, as always. `matchesListingFilter` asks whether the event carries any ticked value (`carries`), not whether its one value is ticked.
- **Offered only where it narrows** (§133, §413): some dates special and some weekly. On a list where every date is special — the seed, a month of races — it is not drawn, unless the address ticks it. **It is a choice on its own:** its other side is a weekly run, a stated answer rather than a question left blank, so where it narrows it is offered even when no type does (every date a group run, some weekly, some not). A type never stands alone anyway: every event has one, so where one narrows a second does.
- **Everywhere the panel is:** the listing's cards ahead and its past section, and the calendar with the look off — not behind «Aspectul nou». **Under the look the chips carry the kind** (§720, `?kind=`), so the box is not offered there: its box and active chip are hidden (`LOOK_HIDDEN_VALUES`, the input stays in the form), the panel's button and `panelUnderLook` do not count it, a kind link drops a ticked SPECIAL (`kindFilter`: a kind choice replaces it) and a lone `type=SPECIAL` reads as the «Evenimente speciale» chip (`chipKind`). One state, never two that contradict.
- **Its words and glyph are the kind's own:** the label is `Event.kind.special` (the photo tag's word, §709), the glyph the calendar chip «Evenimente speciale»'s sparkle (`special`), so one kind wears one word and one picture; the past section's heading names it when it is the one tick («Din trecut — Eveniment special (3)»). No new message key, no new read, no migration: the cadence is on every public row already.

**Refused.** A separate «Felul» group with «Săptămânal» and «Eveniment special»: the owner asked for it under «Tipul», and a weekly box would only be the complement of the special one. A new event type «SPECIAL»: the kind is derived (`docs/REDESIGN.md` decision 9), never a value the club picks. Moving the calendar's `?kind=` into `FILTER_GROUPS`: the chips are one choice, not boxes, and are the look's (§720). The past fold's «every past event is the same» sentence (`singleValues`) names the shared type only, not the kind — a sentence, not a control.
changelogLine: - **«Eveniment special» in the filters' «Tipul»** — the listing's and the calendar's «Filtre» (under «Aspectul nou» the calendar's chips carry it) now offer the special events (every date that is not of a weekly series) beside «Alergare de grup» and «Concurs», wherever the list has both kinds; `?type=SPECIAL`. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The filter's «Tipul» group offers «Eveniment special» (`?type=SPECIAL`, any case; `past-type=SPECIAL` in the past section) for every date that is not of a standing weekly series (§709's `eventKind`): OR with the ticked types, AND with every other group, offered wherever some dates on view are special and some weekly — on its own too, when no type narrows — or where the address ticks it, on the listing and on the calendar with the look off — under the look the kind chips carry it, the box is not offered there, a kind link drops a ticked SPECIAL and a lone SPECIAL reads as the special chip; its label is «Eveniment special» / "Special event" in a 44-pixel box (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
